# Vendor print package

All SVGs in this folder contain outlined lettering: no font installation is required.

## Placement

- Front: `uniform-front-slogan-outline-gold.svg`, centred on chest, artwork size 280 × 240 mm.
- Back: `uniform-back-logo-outline-gold.svg`, centred 70 mm below the collar seam, artwork size 90 × 65 mm.
- Recommended shirt colour: deep forest `#071510`.
- Gold ink: `#E8C88E`; white ink: `#FFFFFF`.

The gold front master intentionally uses white for the first two lines and gold for the italic final two lines. White and forest variants are supplied for alternate shirt colours. Do not scale one axis independently.

Production requires a physical strike-off/sample approval before mass printing. Russian wording also requires fluent review before production.
